messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! I could use a hand with an order I placed recently. My work-from-home dreams just got crushed—turns out, I’ll be back in the office soon. Is it possible to return just the home office stuff from my order and keep the hiking gear? Also, I’d love to know how much I’d get back if that’s doable.

I’m sorry your work-from-home plans didn’t work out! I can help with a partial return (keeping the hiking gear) if your order is eligible—but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **either**:
1) your **email address**, **or**
2) your **first name + last name + ZIP code**.

Once I find your account, tell me the **order id** (e.g., `#W0000000`) so I can check the order status and confirm what “home office stuff” can be returned and estimate the refund.
Sure thing! My name’s Noah Patel and my ZIP code is 10108. I’ll dig up my order number for you—just give me a sec!
noah_patel_6952

Thanks, Noah—I've found your account.

What’s your **order id** (something like `#W0000000`)? Once you share it, I’ll check whether it’s **delivered** (required for returns) and then we can do a return for just the **home office** items while keeping the **hiking gear**, including what refund amount you’d get.

Alright, here it is: my order number is #W1234567. I honestly can’t remember exactly what I ordered for the home office—my brain’s still in “remote work” mode! But if you can see which items are office-related, I’d love to return those and keep the hiking stuff. Let me know what you find and how much I’d get back!
Error: Order not found

I checked `#W1234567`, but the system says **“Order not found.”**  

A couple quick things to verify:
- Make sure the order id is spelled exactly and includes the leading `#` (e.g., `#W0000000`).
- If you have multiple orders, try the other order id.

Please send me the **correct order id**, and (once I can access it) I’ll list the items on the order, identify which ones look “home office” vs “hiking,” and tell you the **refund amount you’d receive** for returning only the office items.
Oh man, classic me—mixing up numbers! Let me double-check my emails and receipts. I’ll get back to you with the right order ID in just a moment. Thanks for your patience!

No problem at all—take your time.  

When you find the correct order id (with the leading `#`), send it here and I’ll:
1) check the order status (returns only work for **delivered** orders),
2) list the items in your order,
3) help identify which ones are “home office” vs “hiking,” and
4) tell you what refund you’d get for returning only the office items.
Alright, found it! The correct order ID is #W9876543. Sorry for the mix-up—my brain’s still hiking up a mountain somewhere. Can you check this one for me?
